description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
 A Day in the Life 
 Are you a highly motivated capital equipment business developer who knows the world of the operating theatre inside out? Do you understand minimally invasive surgery and have the ability to convince both surgeons and hospital budget holders on high-impact decisions regarding medical capital equipment purchases? Are you energized by a highly competitive environment? 
 A Medtronic Surgical Robotics Business Developer is responsible for selling the Medtronic Hugo™ Robotic-Assisted Surgery System to a selected list of our existing hospital clients. This requires several talents, including the ability to build a coalition of supporters within each hospital, strong client engagement and problem-solving skills, the energy to persevere through long and complex sales cycles, and a natural eagerness and drive to bring opportunities to closure. 
 
 Responsibilities may include the following, and other duties may be assigned: 
 Be out in the field and travel frequently to meet with clients and colleagues. Occasionally work from home or from one of our many offices across EMEA 
 Engage with surgical teams to assess opportunities for the expansion of robotic-assisted surgery 
 Engage with C-suite executive decision-makers involved in complex innovation projects and large technology adoption plans 
 Support surgical teams in leading hospitals to enhance and augment their clinical strategy through the use of the Medtronic Hugo™ Surgical Robotic System 
 Convince surgical teams of the benefits offered by the Medtronic Hugo™ Surgical Robotic System, including improved outcomes, benefits to patients, faster recovery, advanced surgical techniques, superior 3D high-resolution imaging during surgery, digital surgical solutions, ease of use for surgical teams, OR efficiency, and cost-effectiveness 
 Engage and convince budget holders and executives in leading hospitals by jointly developing business cases, total cost of ownership (TCO) comparisons, and cost-per-procedure analyses to support informed decisions regarding the purchase and use of the Medtronic Hugo™ Surgical Robotic System 
 Be a proven, positive, and successful collaborator within a matrix organization, managing relationships and delivering outcomes in a multi-stakeholder environment 
 Demonstrate a strong appetite for learning and development, with an interest in technological advancements in healthcare 
 
 Required Knowledge and Experience: 
 Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience leading negotiations and selling complex medical devices or capital equipment, with a proven track record of success 
 Bachelor's degree 
 Native-level Finnish/Danish/Norwegian and proficiency in English 
 You are a winner, but in the right way. You play by the rules, do not cut corners ethically, and respect and adhere to company policies 
 Maintain active networks in the field of surgery and operating theatres, with a network of surgeons with whom you connect regularly 
 Operating room experience 
 Travel/in-field requirement: 70%+ of the time 
  
 
 
 Physical Job Requirements 

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position. 
 
 ‌
 Recruitment Fraud Alert   
 We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:  

 Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.  

 Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.  

 If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.  

 If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com . 
 ‌
  
  
 
 
 Benefits & Compensation 
 Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package 
A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create.   We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.
